description: This Java interface 'InboundExternalMessage' defines the contract for inbound messages received by the Ditto platform, including methods to access the source message, associated topic path, and the mapped signal.

classes.name: InboundExternalMessage
classes.description: An interface representing an inbound message received by Ditto, encapsulating the original external message, topic path, and associated signal.

methods.name: getTopicPath
methods.description: Returns the topic path of the mapped message.

methods.name: getSignal
methods.description: Returns the Signal mapped from the inbound ExternalMessage.
